standard.summary: resident=Transformer blocks 常驻 GPU；block_offload=按需在 CPU 与 GPU 间换入，默认使用 block_offload。
standard.effect: 选择 FLUX.3 Transformer 的驻留和分块换入策略。
standard.whenToUse: 显存足够时可选 resident；显存受限时使用 block_offload。
standard.avoidWhen: 使用 resident 前确认显存能容纳训练所需的模型和激活。

optionDescriptions.resident: 所有 Transformer blocks 常驻 GPU。
optionDescriptions.block_offload: 按 block 在 CPU 与 GPU 间换入。

standard_en.summary: resident keeps Transformer blocks on the GPU; block_offload transfers them between CPU and GPU as needed. Default: block_offload.
standard_en.effect: Selects the FLUX.3 Transformer residency and block-transfer strategy.
standard_en.whenToUse: Use resident when VRAM is sufficient; use block_offload when memory is constrained.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Before choosing resident, confirm that VRAM can hold the model and training activations.

optionDescriptions.resident: Keep all Transformer blocks on the GPU.
optionDescriptions.block_offload: Transfer blocks between CPU and GPU as needed.
